summary: 36 units reviewed word by word. No hard errors found: splits, cases, genders (basti m., pitta n.), verb renderings (pacet should cook, jayet would overcome, sādhya to be prepared), text_flags (śatāhvā x4, āragvadha, rodhra, balākhyam, ojoja metre: 22 syllables confirmed for unit 33) and damaged units 8, 17, 21, 22, 23, 28, 29 are handled per the glossary (unsplit, 'unclear', conjectural). Issues are minor: Hindi plant names not carried as 'X यानी Y' or hedges missing (units 2, 10, 12, 15, 17, 22, 24, 28, 29, 30, 34, 35, 36), English identifications missing on repeat use (12, 17, 24, 28, 34), conjectural marker missing in units 21 and 22, doubtful arghyam given firmly (26), 'burning' supplied twice in 32, added 'तब तक' in 11, standard groups (daśamūla, laghupañcamūla, trisneha, jīvanīya) not spelled out. Identifications judged sound with their tags: balā, guḍūcī, paṭolī, yavānī, vacā, kuṣṭha, śatāhvā (probable), ghana=mustā (probable), priyaṅgu, trāyantikā, tārkṣyaśaila, mākṣika, madhuka, guptā, śrāvaṇī, kośātaka, mūrvā, aśvadaṃṣṭrā, madana (disputed). None judged wrong. No regrouping needed (units 2-6, 10-13, 14-18, 19-21, 22-23, 24-25, 26-27, 29-31, 32-33, 34-36 are continuing sentences, already noted).
glossary_suggestions: Hindi plant names: standard set to use in 'X यानी Y': बला यानी बरियार, पटोली यानी परवल, एरण्ड यानी अरंडी, अश्वगन्धा यानी असगंध, पुनर्नवा यानी सांठी, देवदारु यानी देवदार, कुटज यानी कुड़ा, कुलत्थ यानी कुलथी, बृहती यानी बड़ी कटेरी (probable), विदारी यानी विदारीकन्द (probable), मुद्गपर्णी यानी जंगली मूँग.
ghana (drug) = probably mustā (nut-grass) wherever it appears in a drug list; keep 'probably' and apply the same in Hindi (सम्भवतः नागरमोथा).
madana: hedge as disputed (emetic nut Randia / beeswax) in both languages every time.
Standard groups to spell out once in notes: daśamūla / dvipañcamūla, laghupañcamūla, trisneha, jīvanīya.
Damaged or repaired units: put 'on a conjectural reading' / 'अनुमान से' in both translations, and keep unclear printed words exactly as printed (no ṃ to ṅ change).
